parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true, residing in Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift within the Playback package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 suggests structural overlap, the two methods — AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.stopTransitionsToIdle (line 71) and AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks (line 164) — belong to distinct test classes exercising different behavioral contracts: core state transitions versus idempotency guarantees. Merging or extracting them would conflate separate test intents and couple unrelated behavioral assertions, reducing test clarity without any production benefit.
